rationale: The most recent 5-minute candle was a high-volume bearish engulfing close (290k shares, ~2.4× the prior bar) that printed at its low of $14.55, breaking price back below the 9-EMA ($14.58) that was the primary momentum trigger for entry; the short-term buying pressure cited in the original rationale has demonstrably stalled.
